response.sql:
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), station_shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, telescope_count,
         CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM station_counts
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share
FROM station_shares
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10 WITH TIES;

assumptions.assumption: Includes observatory stations with zero telescopes; if the database has no telescopes, their shares are undefined (division by zero).
